name: ResGen Ltd.
summary: ResGen Ltd. is dedicated to manufacturing pyrolysis oil, which it extracts from various types of plastic waste and scrap. This pyrolysis oil is currently being explored as a viable alternative to traditional petroleum and consists of a complex mix of carbon chains, ranging from C4 to C20. Additionally, the firm generates carbon from plastic refuse. Founded by Karan Atul Bora on September 29, 2018, the company maintains its primary office in Mumbai, India.
